sourceText: Harden proof-or-stop PINN execution plan wording and benchmarks: update plan wording, scope framing, benchmark fairness constraints, task/injection matrix, and milestone status axis so future implementation is unambiguous and non-overstated.
normalizedOutcome: After DONE, users and next implementation stories have a clear, bounded Proof-or-Stop PINN plan with explicit terminology, benchmark fairness constraints, task/injection coverage, and explicit docs-vs-runtime scope boundaries.
acceptanceClaim: This story demonstrates a documented, bounded design handoff and proves no runtime implementation claim is accidentally implied.
